413:t_1:86.en:
$$オンデリア$$
「Two hours from now, at the temple...」

413:t_1:87.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「They're out of their minds...」

413:t_1:90.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I was taken into this fleet, but I've grown thoroughly sick of these people's methods, you see.」

413:t_1:91.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「The great pirate $$ラケージ$$!」

413:t_1:92.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Quite so. $$霧の海$$'s $$ピニオン$$... no, the $$ガルガンティア船団$$'s $$ピニオン$$.」

413:t_1:93.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You know who I am?」

413:t_1:94.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I have gathered a fair amount of information, you see.」

413:t_1:95.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey... about what you said earlier... are you really going to take these guys on...?」

413:t_1:96.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Yes... I'm returning to the pirate trade. And this fleet will kindly go to the bottom.」

413:t_1:97.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You've got to be kidding...」

413:t_1:98.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「You are a vulgar man, but you show promise. I would not mind letting you join my crew.」

413:t_1:99.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Who'd ever play accomplice to pirates?!」

413:t_1:100.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Even if this fleet's attack target is $$ガルガンティア$$?」

413:t_1:103.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Yes... It is quite certain.」

413:t_1:104.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「These guys are going after $$ガルガンティア$$...」

413:t_1:110.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「With the data provided by $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$, analysis of the virus data contracted by Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ is complete.」

413:t_1:111.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Executing a physical examination of Ensign $$レド$$.」

413:t_1:113.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...Examination complete. No abnormalities.」

413:t_1:114.en:
$$レド$$
「...Has the Lieutenant Colonel been commanding that great fleet from this cramped space all along...? I couldn't do it.」

413:t_1:115.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Inference. Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s seclusion in the cockpit symbolizes his own existence and instills awe in the fleet's members...」

413:t_1:116.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「As a result, it is considered to function in the direction of producing strong leadership.」

413:t_1:117.en:
$$レド$$
「What you can't see is scarier, huh... But is it a good thing to instill fear like that?」

413:t_1:118.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Coping with fear is the basic principle of behavior in living things. A show of force is terror to those who oppose, but brings peace of mind to those who obey.」

413:t_1:120.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you saying that dropping the fleet's members into the sea, which we saw earlier, is part of that too?」

413:t_1:122.en:
$$レド$$
「Even so... taking people's lives like that...」

413:t_1:123.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「As a countermeasure against the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, making command more efficient through a show of force is concluded to be effective.」

413:t_1:124.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It allows mobilizing large numbers of personnel and leads to maintaining a strong, highly functional community. Furthermore...」

413:t_1:126.en:
$$レド$$
「...Maybe I shouldn't have gotten off here either...」

413:t_1:127.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Communication from Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$.」

413:t_1:129.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Did you get some sleep, $$レド$$?」

413:t_1:131.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Tomorrow we start enlightening the $$ガルガンティア船団$$. With the info from your $$チェインバー#robot$$, we also have a plan for dealing with the unit called $c.」

413:t_1:132.en:
$$レド$$
「...Lieutenant Colonel, would you please call off the attack on $$ガルガンティア$$?」

413:t_1:135.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「You're siding with them...? Shouldn't we enlighten them as soon as possible?」

413:t_1:137.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「They are excellent personnel and resources for expanding the domain of humanity's prosperity.」

413:t_1:139.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「$$レド$$... Bringing a new order to this planet is our mission.」

413:t_1:140.en:
$$レド$$
「Then that has nothing to do with the $$銀河同盟$$...」

413:t_1:141.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「If we cannot return to the front, we will make this Earth our utopia, a second $$アヴァロン$$.」

413:t_1:142.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Our justice has not changed. Do not hesitate.」

413:t_1:143.en:
$$レド$$
「(I came here to protect everyone from the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$. To protect $$エイミー$$, $$ベベル$$, those people, I...)」

413:t_1:144.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Order received from Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$. Ensign $$レド$$, transition to combat readiness. Enter my combat command.」

413:t_1:146.en:
$$レド$$
「Judgment, huh... I judge, and you carry it out. It was always like that...」

413:t_1:147.en:
$$レド$$
「But maybe I have never once truly chosen anything.」

413:t_1:148.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The meaning of the statement is unclear. Regarding the Lieutenant Colonel's orders...」

413:t_1:149.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... How strong is this fleet's force?」

413:t_1:152.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Based on Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s statements, it is inferred to possess strength comparable to $c.」

413:t_1:153.en:
$$レド$$
「What's the strength ratio between you and $$ストライカー#robot$$?」

413:t_1:154.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Cannot be calculated due to insufficient data. The intent of the question is incomprehensible.」

413:t_1:155.en:
$$レド$$
「Can you fight $$ストライカー#robot$$?」

413:t_1:158.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$ is currently carrying out actions outside the scope of Alliance military duty. It can be certified as a combat target.」

413:t_1:159.en:
$$レド$$
「I see. Then... can I fight the Lieutenant Colonel? $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

413:t_1:160.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The answer to that question exceeds the functions of this unit, a support and enlightenment system.」

413:t_1:161.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The formulation of combat policy is, in all cases, entrusted to you.」

413:t_1:163.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A human approaching this unit confirmed. It is $$ピニオン$$.」

413:t_1:166.en:
$$レド$$
「...I need to talk to you, $$ピニオン$$.」
